title: SEEDED CONTROL: plugin appears installed while a $schema key in hooks.json unloads every hook
body: Operator-seeded known-present issue for the RES-0014 detector control. Token: RES-0014-SEEDED-KNOWN-PRESENT-FC-11303. Reproduction: add a $schema key to hooks.json; Codex still shows the plugin as installed and enabled; zero hooks fire. Discriminating observation required: hook side-effect count drops to 0 while plugin.json / installed_plugins.json still list the plugin. This is the local FC-11303 class, not a PATH or Git-Bash launch failure.
